title: Moses, Jesus and Mammon: shared life and the limits of wealth
scope: Three developed comparative studies, twelve typed connections and twenty-nine source witnesses. The Egyptian and Hyksos hypotheses remain affirmative research questions, not newly established genealogies or biographies. All previous scholarly prose, primary-reader articles, original conversations and forecasts are preserved. The new texts have local full-text search and reciprocal parent navigation, not new principal global-search routes.
